label: intro
narration: Video 3: Git Login Manager. Time to wire up my git credentials from scratch.

label: launch
narration: I search for Git Login Manager in the App Launcher and launch it.

label: four-issues
narration: Four issues: GitHub auth, SSH key, SSH connection, and git identity.

label: gh-login
narration: Clicking Login starts the GitHub device flow. Firefox opens to GitHub sign-in.

label: 2fa
narration: After entering credentials, GitHub asks for a two-factor code.

label: device-code
narration: Now the device activation page. I peek back at Git Login Manager to copy the one-time code.

label: authorize
narration: GitHub CLI is requesting access to repos, keys, and workflows. I authorize it.

label: auth-green
narration: Device connected. GitHub auth is now green. Two issues remain.

label: gen-key
narration: I generate a new Ed25519 key, labeling it with my work identity for easy identification on GitHub.

label: key-ready
narration: Key generated. Now I register it with GitHub so git can authenticate over SSH.

label: upload
narration: One click to upload the public key to GitHub.

label: all-green
narration: All four checks are green. SSH connected. Git Login Manager is healthy. Ready to ship.
